title: San Francisco · Street traffic
description: The original 13-second street traffic demo, preserved alongside newer examples.

source.title: Street traffic
source.author: Editor
source.changes: Excerpt at 21–34 seconds; resized to 1280×720 at 12 FPS; audio removed; detections and HUD added only to the analyzed version.

limitation: Small, distant and occluded road users may be missed; buses and trucks are excluded from Cars.

title: Shibuya · Crossing
description: 45 seconds at Shibuya Crossing. Compare low-resolution crowd footage with local detections.

source.title: Shibuya Crossing
source.author: Emran Kassim
source.changes: First 45 seconds; upscaled from 640×480 to 960×720 at 12 FPS with aspect ratio preserved; audio removed; detections and HUD added only to the analyzed version.

limitation: The 640×480 source misses many distant people and some cars. Upscaling adds no detail; this is not a crowd census.

title: Retail HD · Al Basheer
description: Walk through an HD shopping center: aisles, walking shoppers and the checkout area.

source.title: Al Basheer shopping center, Najaf
source.author: Al Basheer Shopping Center (مركز البشير للتسوق)
source.changes: Excerpt at 6–51 seconds; native HD 1280×720 retained at 12 FPS; audio removed; detections and HUD added only to the analyzed version.

limitation: Camera movement, scene cuts, shelves, occlusion and people printed on packaging can affect detections. These are per-frame model estimates, not unique shoppers.

title: Apples HD · Pressing day
description: A 30-second landscape excerpt of baskets of apples and fruit entering a press at Roscheider Hof. Count accepted apple detections in each frame.

source.title: RoscheiderhofKeltertag2018
source.author: Helge Klaus Rieder / Freilichtmuseum Roscheider Hof
source.changes: Source seconds 8–38; landscape 1920×1080 resized to 1280×720 at 12 FPS without cropping or stretching; all audio removed. Only the analyzed derivative adds apple detections and HUD. Both video derivatives remain CC BY-SA 3.0.

limitation: Accepted apple detections per frame, not the total apples in the basket or a running production count. Occlusion, motion blur, scene cuts, chopped fruit and clustered apples cause misses and grouped boxes. Some shots show machinery rather than whole fruit.
